name.ja: ＨＧ 1/144 ジム (モロッコ戦線仕様)

description.ja: 映画『機動戦士ガンダム ククルス・ドアンの島』より、カサブランカの町で登場するRGM-79 ジム（モロッコ戦線仕様）がＨＧで商品化。
description.en: From the movie ``Mobile Suit Gundam: The Island of Cucurrus Doan'', the RGM-79 Jim (Moroccan front specification) that appears in the town of Casablanca is commercialized by HG.

description.ja: 特徴的な機体形状・カラーリングを成形色で再現。ショルダー・キャノンやビーム・スプレーガン（前期型）等の武装が付属。
description.en: The characteristic aircraft shape and coloring are reproduced with molded colors. Armaments such as a shoulder cannon and beam spray gun (early model) are included.

description.ja: 劇中でも描かれている機体識別のナンバーマークに加え、オリジナルデザインのコーションマークを含む新規水転写式デカールが同梱。
description.en: In addition to the aircraft identification number mark depicted in the movie, a new water transfer decal including an original design caution mark is included.

description.ja: ●新規造形を交え、モロッコ戦線のジムを再現
description.en: -Reproduce the gym of the Moroccan front with new modeling

description.ja: カサブランカの町で、サザンクロス隊と交戦するジムを新規造形を交えて再現。
description.en: The gym that fights the Southern Cross squad in the town of Casablanca is recreated with new modeling.

description.ja: ジム（スレッガー搭乗機）とは異なる頭部、胸部、肩部形状を忠実に立体化。
description.en: The head, chest, and shoulder shapes are faithfully three-dimensional, which is different from Jim (Slegger's aircraft).

description.ja: オレンジ・ライトグレーを主体としたカラーリングをパーツ分割による色分けで忠実に再現。
description.en: The coloring, mainly orange and light gray, is faithfully reproduced by color-coding by dividing the parts.

description.ja: 頭部／胸部コクピットハッチ／肩部
description.en: Head/Thorax Cockpit Hatch/Shoulders

description.ja: スレッガー搭乗機とは形状の異なる側頭部ダクトやコクピットハッチなど各部形状を細やかなディテールまで忠実に再現。
description.en: The shape of each part, such as the side duct and cockpit hatch, which have a different shape from the Slegger aircraft, is faithfully reproduced down to the smallest details.

description.ja: メインカメラにはグリーンのクリアパーツを採用。
description.en: The main camera uses green clear parts.

description.ja: ●ショルダー・キャノンやビーム・スプレーガン（前期型）等の武装が付属。
description.en: - Comes with weapons such as shoulder cannon and beam spray gun (early model).

description.ja: 背部ショルダー・キャノンやビーム・ライフル、ビーム・サーベル、シールドに加えビーム・スプレーガン（前期型）が付属。
description.en: In addition to the back shoulder cannon, beam rifle, beam saber, and seal, a beam spray gun (early model) is included.

description.ja: 武器持ち手、平手などポージングの幅を広げるハンドパーツもセット。
description.en: Hand parts such as weapon holders and open hands are also included to expand the range of poses.

description.ja: ●新規水転写式デカールが同梱。
description.en: -New water transfer decal included.

description.ja: 劇中出演の小隊機であることを示すナンバーマークなどを収録した水転写式デカールが付属。
description.en: A water slide decal is included that includes a number mark indicating that it is a platoon aircraft that appeared in the play.

description.ja: 付属武装： ビーム・スプレーガン（前期型） ／ ビーム・ライフル ／ シールド ／ ビーム・サーベル ／ ショルダー・キャノン
description.en: Attached weapons: Beam spray gun (early model) / Beam rifle / Seal / Beam saber / Shoulder cannon

description.en: 1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model
